root_cause: GitHub installation API exhaustion returned HTTP 403 but protected admission classified it as generic CONTROL_PLANE_ADMISSION_ERROR instead of transient provider read capacity, producing misleading incident evidence and unnecessary manual diagnosis.

evidence.rate_limit_class: API rate limit exceeded for installation (HTTP 403)

fix: Canonical, pure error classification emits CONTROL_PLANE_RATE_LIMITED and stable fingerprint; no immediate retries on rate exhaustion. Existing 502/503/504 transport retries remain bounded. Ordinary authorization 403 remains permanent control-plane failure.
prevention_rule: Do not retry rate-exhausted GitHub installation requests within tight CI loops; preserve one provider-capacity fingerprint; only the pre-existing watchdog may decide later bounded recovery with fresh provider evidence.

invariants: A generic unauthorized 403 never becomes recoverable rate exhaustion
Rate exhaustion never adds an API burst
No new workflow, scheduler or error registry
